For $n\le82$ the rule disagrees with Toda in $\pi_{49}$, $\pi_{50}$, $\pi_{51}$, $\pi_{59}$, $\pi_{60}$, $\pi_{63}$, $\pi_{64}$, $\pi_{66}$, $\pi_{67}$, $\pi_{68}$, $\pi_{69}$, $\pi_{70}$, $\pi_{73}$, $\pi_{74}$, $\pi_{75}$, $\pi_{76}$, $\pi_{77}$, $\pi_{79}$, $\pi_{80}$. Almost all of the extra classes are removed by arrows $d_5$ that do not change the colour; at $p=3$ this is $d_{2p-1}$, the length of Toda's differential. Disagreements remain in $\pi_{57}$, $\pi_{58}$, $\pi_{63}$, $\pi_{64}$, $\pi_{66}$, $\pi_{67}$, $\pi_{73}$, $\pi_{74}$, $\pi_{75}$, $\pi_{76}$, $\pi_{78}$, $\pi_{79}$, $\pi_{80}$: there the greedy $d_5$ kills classes that are alive in Toda. So Toda needs some colour-preserving $d_5$, but not all the allowed ones. None of the purely colour-based variants we checked reproduces Toda beyond $\pi_{48}$.
